name: Echoform Scan Parameter - Playhead Modulation Range
description: Validates scan parameter (0.0-1.0) controls playhead offset range. Tests at maximum scan depth (1.0) to verify full modulation range without instability.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests scan parameter at maximum (1.0) for full playhead modulation

has_output.description: Scan at 1.0 should produce audible modulation

no_clipping.description: Maximum scan depth should not cause clipping

high_variance.description: Scan=1.0 should create significant temporal modulation (playhead moving)

no_excessive_discontinuities.description: Manual scan should be smooth (no zipper noise or clicks)

use_cases: Verify scan parameter controls playhead offset range
Test maximum scan depth (1.0 = full buffer range)
Validate smooth playhead modulation (no zipper noise)
Ensure no instability at extreme scan values
pass_criteria: High variance output from playhead modulation, smooth transitions, no clipping
example_failures: Low variance → scan parameter not working
Clipping → gain issue at full scan range
